## Checklist

- [ ] The listing points at a full 40-character commit SHA in a public repository I own.
- [ ] The repository has `manifest.json`, `files/`, `cover.png` (1200 × 630) and at least one picture in `screenshots/`.
- [ ] For an update, the manifest's `version` is higher than the listed one.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes.
- [ ] The code is readable and not minified, and it works in light and dark mode.
- [ ] I may share everything in it under the MIT licence.
